entries.english:
Disputes with the Teutonic Order and Hohenlohe-Weikersheim concerning the deserted hamlet of Reckertsfelden.

Term: 1536, 1560, 1671, 1692–1743, 1759.

Contents: 1. disputes between Zaisolph von Rosenberg and the Teutonic Order over Rosenberg subjects’ refusal to pay dues on Teutonic Order properties at Reckertsfelden, 1560; 2. disputes between Hohenlohe-Weikersheim and Hatzfeldt over the tax assessment in the Reckertsfelden district, 1654, 1671, 1696, 1704–1706, 1723–1739; 3. disputes between Hatzfeldt and Hohenlohe-Weikersheim concerning Reckertsfelden, 1692, 1706, 1717–1726, 1740; 4. disputes between Hatzfeldt and Hohenlohe-Weikersheim over, among other matters, rebuilding the deserted hamlet, hunting rights, and crimes by Hohenlohe-Weikersheim subjects in Hatzfeldt territory, 1706–1722, 1735–1736; 5. disputes between the Teutonic Order and Hohenlohe-Weikersheim over assessment of Teutonic Order hereditary fief properties belonging to Hatzfeldt subjects at Staigerbach in the Reckertsfelden district, 1536, 1699, 1716, 1740, 1741–1743; 6. petition by Johann Ludwig Krauß, Amtmann zu Weikersheim for payment of outstanding taxes from Hatzfeldt subjects, 1759.

Extent: 1 file.
